reviews.title: Good app, but I would like more customization
reviews.text:
To be clear, I love a lot about this app. It’s brought my screen time down a lot since I started using it, and even though it’s paid, I think it’s a great investment. That being said, there are a couple of changes I would like to see. 

First, I don’t like the gem limit. I like being able to track all my activities, but I want them to count towards the gems. 

Second, I think you should be able to add activities you did in the past. For example, if I’m reading for half an hour and I forget to log that in the moment, I can’t add that back and then I don’t get any ‘credit’, for lack of a better term. 

I also think you should be able to add/take away activities. For example, I’m not Christian/Catholic, but I am Pagan and want to be able to having praying to my own gods in there. I also would like to add things like washing my face, or just other things like that. I think being able to add those and then have the gem reward be comparable to other, similar, tasks would be helpful. 

Also, whenever you spend gems, Rottie gets really sad, and that makes me uncomfortable. If I earned the gems, I feel like I should be able to spend them without having the character cry. 

These are just my thoughts, but overall it’s a really good app.
